notes:
Sua loi scrcpy chet tren nhieu may ("read codec id: unexpected end of file"): APK nap lib trong chinh APK thay vi file libdaomai_cv.so cu o /data/local/tmp, kiem symbol, khong de luong video chet; app cai de APK moi (versionCode theo build), pm install hong thi chay tu file da day; o hien dung ly do loi cua scrcpy.

Da PC doi xung: moi PC vua server vua node, chi can nhap ip:port; tab gon lai nhu Thẻ (bo Quet LAN va Khoi dong lai adb): may tren PC nay tick = chia se, moi peer mot nhom gap (tick = noi), chip so may dung chung hinh dang/mau voi Thẻ; A va B tro lan nhau khong de quy (adb DaoMai 6.5.1 nhung san).

Khe luoi theo canh ngan cua o (dung/ngang deu nhau khi xoay).

May offline chon duoc lai o Luoi va Thẻ (boi den, shift, bam); chip/the dang chon cua may offline chi ve VIEN do (khong to nen) de phan biet voi may online dang chon; thong bao "Dang chon" o thanh trang thai chi dem may online.
